title: The Team's daily audit, on staging only (Piece 2, P2-4)
why: Jason's Piece 2 (decisions/0179; handoffs/piece2-team.md §6, approved 2026-11-25): once a day on staging the Operations & Reconciliation Manager reads Site health's findings, late or failed jobs and open alarms, opens one Audit ticket per new finding, and a day later confirms it (opening a Work ticket, or a Resolution for a Tier 3) or clears it as noise. Nothing runs on live.

changes.what: The daily audit (team_audit_tick), staging only, under the Team's runner switch
Run the audit now, on the Operations & Reconciliation Manager's card (greyed on live, with why)
Audit tickets in the Work queue: Found, then Confirmed or cleared as noise; the Audit closes with the ticket it opened
FAQ: What is the Team's daily audit?
